other_text: DORIS WAS A YOUNG GIRL WHO WAS SENT TO A MENTAL INSTITUTION BY HER FAMILY AFTER SHE WAS ACCUSED OF KILLING HER GRANDMOTHER. DURING HER TIME IN THE INSTITUTION SHE WAS SUBJECTED TO SEVERE PHYSICAL AND PSYCHOLOGICAL ABUSE BY THE STAFF. ONE DAY SHE ESCAPED FROM THE INSTITUTION AND BEGAN A JOURNEY OF SELF-DISCOVERY AND REVENGE. SHE MET A GROUP OF PEOPLE WHO SHARED HER PAIN AND TOGETHER THEY FORMED A COMMUNITY THAT EMBRACED THEIR DIFFERENCES AND FOUND STRENGTH IN UNITY.
